UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Stores an authenticated learner's lesson completions, quiz answers, Code Lab runs, AI Tutor question count, and last visited language.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the learner.

completedLessons.description: List of completed tutorial lesson IDs (max 50).

quizAnswers.description: Map of quiz question ID to selected option index (max 50 entries).

codeRuns.description: Total number of Code Lab runs by the learner.

tutorQuestions.description: Total number of AI Tutor questions asked by the learner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the progress document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the progress document was last updated.

/userProgress/{userId}.description: Owner-only learning progress document keyed by the user's Firebase Auth UID.
